source: Liu et al. (2021), DOI:10.1371/journal.pone.0255793, Tables 2–3, Eq.15
medium: web teaching figures; no journal submission target
design_plot: Three orthogonal a–b slices at c=-1,0,+1. Identical design positions grouped and explicitly counted; no jitter.
diagnostics: All 17 rows; parity axes equal aspect and limits [-30,60]; residual limits [-15,15] identical across models.
web_panels: Individual web panels are exported with each axes tight bounds plus 0.02 inch padding; web images scale responsively.
overlap: Exact parity coordinate overlaps use point area proportional to row count, labelled ×4. All residual rows shown individually.
uncertainty: No uncertainty intervals estimated. Replicated parameter rows are not asserted to be independent experiments.
transformations: paper physical polynomial or full quadratic OLS refit

overview.design: all 13 positions in three c slices, repeated center counted ×5; record ids available in sample sheet and raw data dialog
overview.diagnostics: all 17 rows; common limits and overlap count retained; no filtering or jitter
